question: Does ANY linear function of the eight cycle-visible feedback fields rank the held-out primary OUT OF SAMPLE (fitted on every other chain, applied to a chain never seen)? And is the only out-of-sample signal on this substrate the prior over configurations rather than the feedback?

inputs.source_root: /projects/hep/fs9/users/scyiu/orion-v2-e45/ (LUNARC; per-file sha256 inside the tuples file)
inputs.truth: quantitative_test_evaluation.output_graph.wasserstein_distance.mean of the cycle's own metrics.json (lower better); read only here, never by any decision artifact
inputs.m2_epoch_model_label: the m2 F2 decisions were produced by a served model that is UNRECOVERABLE (no per-call model id); it is INFERRED, not verified, and is not glm-5.3

feature_sets.CFG: regime one-hot (observational, partial_interventional, interventional) + frac + frac^2

ranker.model: ridge regression, columns standardised on the training fold, target centred
ranker.fold: leave-one-CHAIN-out over all 36 chains (F0 and F2 chains pooled; F0's four runs are treated as four cycles)
ranker.statistic_per_chain: Spearman(prediction, truth) over the held-out chain's 4 rows; positive = ranks truth correctly; and top1_hit = argmin(pred) == argmin(truth), chance 0.25
ranker.pooled: arithmetic mean of per-chain Spearman over chains with a defined rho

IB1_IB2.kind: within-chain permutation of truth with full LOCO refit

controls_evaluated_first_and_consumed_by.M4_M1_REPRODUCED: per-chain raw Spearman(pooled_biological_evaluation, wasserstein), arithmetic mean over the 12 F2 chains of each cohort, equals m4's frozen pooled_rho_arithmetic (P = m3 F2, R = m2 F2) to 1e-9
controls_evaluated_first_and_consumed_by.M2_M3_PRIMARY_AND_CENSUS_REPRODUCED: F0_best - F2_final mean over 12 pairs equals the m2 receipt's -0.008979 and the m3 receipt's -0.007414 to 1e-6; m2 F0 best-of-4 regime census equals interventional 5 / observational 4 / partial 3
controls_evaluated_first_and_consumed_by.PLANTED_SIGNAL_DETECTED: run_time replaced on a copy by truth + N(0, 0.25 sd(truth)) (seed 20260904); the FB8 ranker must reach mean rho >= 0.5 with perm p <= 0.05 at 400 permutations
controls_evaluated_first_and_consumed_by.NULL_CALIBRATION: 100 within-chain truth shuffles, each tested with 200 permutations; rejection rate at alpha 0.05 must lie in [0.02, 0.09] (seed 20260903)

gates.IB0_CONTROLS_VALID: all four controls PASS and all 144 envelopes valid; else CANNOT_CHECK, exit 5, nothing filed
gates.IB1_FEEDBACK_RANKS_TRUTH_OOS: pooled mean rho(FB8) > 0 and perm p <= 0.05
gates.IB2_CONFIG_RANKS_TRUTH_OOS: pooled mean rho(CFG) > 0 and perm p <= 0.05
gates.IB3_FEEDBACK_ADDS_TO_CONFIG: mean over chains of rho(FB8+CFG) - rho(CFG) > 0 with sign-flip p <= 0.05

routing.IB1 fires: OOS_RANKER_EXISTS__PROSPECTIVE_M5PP_WARRANTED -- contradicts the m5' in-sample screen; licenses ONLY a prospective campaign under its own freeze, no revival claim
routing.IB1 not fired, IB2 fires: CHANNEL_INFORMATION_BOUND__PRIOR_OVER_CONFIGS_IS_THE_ONLY_OOS_SIGNAL -- the information a sequential loop could exploit is not in the feedback; it is in the prior over configurations, which an upfront federation exploits without feedback

reachability_audit_pre_run.seed_does_something: yes: the permutation, sign-flip, plant and null-calibration draws
reachability_audit_pre_run.hard_gate_at_scale: 36 chains x 2000 permutations x 3 feature sets in pure Python; no crash path at this scale
reachability_audit_pre_run.contrast_could_exist: yes: per-chain rho ranges over {-1,...,+1}; the planted control must reach >= 0.5 and the shuffled null must sit near 0
reachability_audit_pre_run.clause_reachable_both_ways: IB1/IB2/IB3 each satisfiable (the plant satisfies IB1's form) and failable (the null-calibration shuffles fail it)
reachability_audit_pre_run.comparator_isolation: not applicable -- no arm is run; the F0 and F2 tuples are pooled as substrate samples, not contrasted
